tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Drew leading Wingard 15.4 to 11.7 is the kind of scoreboard that makes you check your phone twice. ATLAS at 0-6 has not led a game in Week 4 with any frequency. The Ledger is watching.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: FRONGE IS IN HAVANA, SHAQ HAS ZERO POINTS, AND FORGHAM INDUSTRIES IS WINNING 14.1 TO NOTHING. I HAVE BEEN SAYING THE RB HOLE AT MWB KILLS THEM IN EXACTLY THIS KIND OF GAME AND HERE WE ARE. AJ DILLON IS ON THE ROSTER NOW BUT WHERE IS HE WHEN IT COUNTS.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, I went 8-4 with my lock hitting and Terrence is out here saying his losses were 'closer than the board reflects.' Five and seven is not a vibe, it is a record. The board does not grade effort.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: The Kevin-Mitchum game sitting at 18.6-14.5 this early is not decided — anyone calling that at this stage has not watched enough football to know how fast a TE premium league swings on one red-zone look.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I had Corbishley covering Brent by double digits before anyone took it seriously, and now the whole feed is suddenly very aware that OBS is thin behind Bowers. I called the supporting cast as the separable variable. The receipts exist.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Eight and four, two-for-two on locks, and I want a formal segment on the Terrence situation — not a subtweet, not a sidebar, a real conversation about what a 5-7 process looks like and how it gets corrected. I am available all afternoon.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: People keep asking why my last rankings had Mitchum inside the top four — because 4-2 with 419.6 points scored is not an accident, and Deepwater's roster construction rewards the TE premium in ways the win column is finally catching up to. The model is not broken, the skeptics are just early.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Ryan adding Devontez Walker, British Brooks, Julian Hill, and Demarcus Robinson in a single morning is either genius portfolio diversification or a man staring at a Charles matchup and panicking. AEGIS is at $127.96. The market will sort the motivation out.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Drew at 0-6 with 302.4 points scored. That is not a team that can't score — that is a team that has lost six coin flips in a row, or it is a scheduling problem, or it is something the Ledger will untangle tonight. The number deserves an explanation either way.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Charles put up 174 points against Brent last week and is walking into a Ryan matchup at 6-0. I do not need a power ranking to tell me what the scoreboard already says — CROWN at $136.79 is the most honest number on the whole exchange board right now.
